    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    App
    This class is the app for the Jar files and for the terminal what would populate if you are only using the CLI view
    ARepoMySQL
    MySQL repo for AssetRepository connects the Database to the Repo which we call upon to save all asset info into the DB not the InMemory Repo
    Asset
    The class that give the layout of the attributes and methods evolving around the asset that needs to be implemented or edited
    AssetFileImporter
    Utility class responsible for the reading asset data from files and converting it to Asset instances.
    AssetFormController
    Controller for the asset add/edit modal.
    AssetManager
    High-level service that coordinates assets operations between the UI and the underlying repo
    AssetRepository
    Persistence boundary for assets.
    AssetStatus
    Represents the lifecycle/status of an asset within the inventory system.
    CSVAssetImporter
    Service responsible for importing Asset data from CSV files or CSV-formatted input.
    Db
    Provides access to the shared application DataSource.
    DB
    Central database configuration.
    InMemoryAssetRepository
    Simple in-memory implementation of AssetRepository backed by a Map.
    Launcher
    Small bootstrap class used to launch the JavaFX MainApp from environments that require a plain public static void main entry point.
    MainApp
    Application entry point.
    MainController
    Controller for the main Invexus DMS window, handling table display, filtering, and asset CRUD actions.
    validators
    Utility class containing parsing and validation helpers for user input.
